entry.title: New: Resolution 605 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE MAYOR TO ENTER INTO AN AGREEMENT WITH THE STATE OF HAWAI‘I DEPARTMENT OF BUSINESS, ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND TOURISM, THE CITY AND COUNTY OF HONOLULU, THE COUNTY OF MAUI, AND THE COUNTY OF KAUA‘I, PURSUANT TO HAWAI‘I REVISED STATUTES SECTION 46-7, TO SUPPORT THE DEVELOPMENT OF HAWAI‘I’S CREATIVE ECONOMY

Establishes and defines the roles of each entity to execute a plan on shared marketing efforts, develop a strategic road map, implement plans to support workforce development, align County and State Film Office integration, and institute cost sharing to support the development of Hawai‘i’s creative economy.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 605-24 - 9/4/2024
